regions.region: page 4 upper Scheme 3 shared arrow, twelve scope boxes, caption, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: All twelve displayed substrate runs were recorded separately with both isolated branches, product-specific yields and ee values, S-factors, shared N2/caption conditions, and all footnote overrides. Na2CO3 is an explicit participant for 1e; the 32% no-Na2CO3 comparison is a separate control record.

Recorded the distinct rac-1m kinetic resolution with 1.0 w/w Lipozyme TL-IM, vinyl acetate 2 equiv, cyclohexane, N2, room temperature, 24 h, recovered (R)-1m 61%/48% ee, ester (S)-3m 35%/88% ee, and S = 25.
Recorded AgNO3-mediated cyclization of (S)-1a in H2O/acetone 1:1 at reflux for 8 h to (S)-4a, 85% yield and 98% ee.

Recorded the separate Shvo-catalyzed toluene/70 °C/4 h cycloisomerization to (S)-4b, 66% yield and >99% ee. The printed catalyst loading '2.0 mmol%' is retained as an unresolved source expression rather than silently corrected.
